defs.def: to send out air from the mouth 吹

ex.s: Protect your property: close windows and tape them up, and bring indoors anything that could blow away.
ex.t: 保护你的财物：关好窗户并用胶带封住，把任何可能被吹走的东西收进室内。

ex.s: Strong winds driven by gravity blow from the pole to the coastline, while other winds blow round the coast.
ex.t: 由重力驱动的高风从极地吹向海岸，而其他风则沿着海岸吹拂。

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

defs.def: when the wind or a current of air blows, it is moving; when it blows, the wind is blowing 刮；吹

ex.s: Life is queer with its twists and turns, As every one of us sometimes learns, And many a failure turns about, When he might have won had he stuck it out; Don't give up though the pace seems slow - You may succeed with another blow.
ex.t: 生活充满了曲折，我们每个人有时都会体会到，多少次的失败本可转为成功，只要他们当初坚持下去；即使步伐似乎缓慢，也千万不要放弃——你或许下一次努力就会成功。

ex.s: Bricks covered the ground like red autumn leaves, but no wind could blow them away.
ex.t: 砖块像红色的秋叶一样覆盖地面，但没有任何风能把它们吹走。

ex.s: Give yourself a test．Which way is the wind blowing?
ex.t: 给自己做个测试。风往哪个方向吹？

defs.def: to be moved by the wind, sb's breath, etc; to move sth in this way （被）刮动，吹动
if you blow a whistle, musical instrument, etc. or if a whistle, etc. blows, you produce a sound by blowing into the whistle, etc. 吹，吹奏（哨子、乐器等）；（哨子、乐器等）吹奏出音
to clear your nose by blowing strongly through it into a tissue or handkerchief 擤（鼻子）
to kiss your hand and then pretend to blow the kiss towards sb （向某人）送飞吻
to make or shape sth by blowing 吹出（某物）；把（某物）吹出形状
if a fuse blows or you blow a fuse, the electricity stops flowing suddenly because the fuse (= a thin wire) has melted because the current was too strong （使保险丝）熔化，烧断
to break open or apart, especially because of pressure from inside; to make a tyre break in this way 破裂；爆裂；爆胎
to break sth open with explosives 炸开
to make known sth that was secret 泄露；暴露
to spend or waste a lot of money on sth （在某事物上）花大钱，挥霍
to waste an opportunity 浪费（机会）
（表示生气、吃惊或不在乎）
to leave a place suddenly 突然离开（某地）
to destroy sb/sth completely 彻底摧毁；毁灭
to show that sb/sth is not good by being very much better than it/them （以更加优异者）表明 … 不好，显得 … 差得多
to completely destroy sth in an explosion 炸毁；炸掉
to show that an idea is completely false 推翻（观点）；表明 … 是错误的
to kill sb by shooting them 枪杀某人
to impress sb a lot or to make them very happy 给某人留下深刻印象；使某人很高兴
to defeat sb easily 轻易击败某人
if a flame, etc. blows out, it is put out by the wind, etc. 被（风等）吹灭；熄灭
if an oil or gas well blows out, it sends out gas suddenly and with force （油井或气井）喷气；井喷
to explode; to be destroyed by an explosion 爆炸；被炸毁
to start suddenly and with force 爆发
to destroy sth by an explosion 炸毁
to fill sth with air or gas so that it becomes firm 给（某物）充气
to make a photograph bigger 放大（照片）
to make sth seem more important, better, worse, etc. than it really is 夸大；夸张
a hard hit with the hand, a weapon, etc. （用手、武器等的）猛击
a sudden event which has damaging effects on sb/sth, causing sadness or disappointment 打击；挫折

ex.s: Yang’s death was a huge blow to his loyal troops, but they turned sorrow into anger and continued to fight fiercely against the invaders.
ex.t: 杨靖宇的死对他忠诚的部队是一个巨大的打击，但他们化悲痛为愤怒，继续与侵略者激烈战斗。

defs.def: the action of blowing 吹
